status: Experimental complete retained heading sessions verified; fresh full run passed all 17 release gates
scope: Rust-only Session Checkpoint V4; not browser heading support or local-log integration

contract.binding: Exact durable schema selector and fingerprint before history interpretation; exact process-local context for encoding
contract.wireHistory: Chronological forward operations and exact result selections/pending formats; no serialized inverses
contract.replay: Every entry is replayed forward and its locally derived inverse is replayed backward before assembling a restored session, including future redo entries
contract.admission: Entry and aggregate operation counts admitted before owned operations or history boundaries; individual V4 payload preflight before reconstruction
contract.bounds: Outer JSON bytes, host history capacity, per-entry and aggregate operations, per-fragment and full-document budgets, cumulative retained nodes/text/properties including pending formats
contract.legacyCompatibility: V1-V3 unchanged; old entry points reject V4 and V4 does not auto-upgrade older envelopes
contract.authenticity: Replay proves internal consistency, not provenance or authorization

verification.focusedCommand: PROPTEST_CASES=10000 PROPTEST_RNG_SEED=20261003 cargo test -p breditor-core --lib --all-features --locked session_checkpoint
coverage: Independent-context restoration at every undo/redo cursor
Exact document, Unicode selection, typed formats and pending formats at every boundary
Mixed multi-block paragraph/heading spans and backward selections

Exact byte and retained-state budgets, including heading ranks and pending properties
Whole-document result limits enforced during replay, beyond individual fragment admission
Malformed topology, unknown/duplicate fields, mixed generations and serialized inverses rejected
No-op recipes rejected while net-zero content recipes remain history events
